title: Buying Vintage & Preowned Hermès Bags: Styles, Sizes and What to Look For
summary: Find your perfect Hermès bag in the secondary luxury market.
body_markdown:
[Hermès Birkin 35 HSS in Braise and Black Porosus Crocodile, Contemporary](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/top-handle-bags/hermes-birkin-35-hss-braise-black-porosus-crocodile-gold-special-order-rare/id-v_21490562/)


Thinking about acquiring a luxury vintage bag for your collection?


This guide on how to buy[Hermès bags](https://www.1stdibs.com/creators/hermes/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/) describes the most iconic styles and explains how to assess condition and choose the right size for your first purchase.


Each Hermès bag has a distinct history, silhouette and way of carrying. The house’s flagship models — the[Birkin](https://www.1stdibs.com/designs/hermes-birkin-bag/) ,[Kelly](https://www.1stdibs.com/designs/hermes-kelly-bag/) and[Constance](https://www.1stdibs.com/designs/hermes-constance-bag/) — remain its most sought-after.


---


## **Meet the Icons: Birkin, Kelly, Constance and Beyond**


[Hermès Birkin 30 Jaune De Naples Epsom Leather, 21st century](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/top-handle-bags/hermes-birkin-30-jaune-de-naples-epsom-leather-palladium-hardware/id-v_30419582/)


### **The Birkin**


The[Birkin bag](https://www.1stdibs.com/designs/hermes-birkin-bag/) , which debuted in 1984, was born of a chance meeting on a plane between Jane Birkin and then–Hermès CEO Jean-Louis Dumas. The singer/actress told Dumas that, as a mother, she needed a more practical leather bag with pockets.


The Birkin addressed those needs. A roomy flap-top, rectangular bag with a lock and key closure, it is intended to be carried by hand or in the crook of the arm.


[Hermes Kelly 32 Rose Azalee Bag Evercolor Leather, 21st century](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/shoulder-bags/hermes-kelly-32-rose-azalee-bag-palladium-hardware-evercolor-leather/id-v_29968812/)


### **The Kelly**


The Sac à Dépêches, introduced around 1935, was renamed the[Kelly bag](https://www.1stdibs.com/designs/hermes-kelly-bag/) after Princess Grace Kelly brought it into the spotlight by using it to shield her pregnancy from paparazzi.


The Kelly has a more formal, trapezoidal silhouette. It is available with a rigid Sellier or softer Retourne construction and can be carried by its single top handle or worn hands-free using its detachable shoulder strap.


[Hermès Constance 1-18 Celeste Epsom Leather, 21st century](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/top-handle-bags/hermes-constance-1-18-celeste-epsom-leather-gold-hardware-handbag/id-v_30989922/)


### **The Constance**


The classic Constance, which debuted in 1959, was designed by Catherine Chaillet, who named it after her newborn daughter. It was later popularized by Jacqueline Kennedy.


The[Constance bag](https://www.1stdibs.com/buy/hermes-constance-bags/) is sleek and compact, defined by a large H-shaped clasp. It is versatile, able to be carried in multiple ways depending on the model: Some wear it as a shoulder or crossbody bag, whereas others prefer to use it as a clutch.


### **Other Styles and Quotas**


These icons are not the only covetable Hermès models. Among the house’s lesser-known styles that are worth knowing are the[Lindy](https://www.1stdibs.com/buy/hermes-lindy/) ,[Evelyne](https://www.1stdibs.com/buy/hermes-evelyne/) ,[Garden Party](https://www.1stdibs.com/buy/hermes-garden-party/) and[Bolide](https://www.1stdibs.com/buy/hermes-bolide/) .


If you are a collector or just love Hermès bags, bear in mind that the Birkin, Kelly (and sometimes Constance) bags are subject to the house’s in-store quota system, meaning that no customer can buy more than two of these bags in a calendar year. Luckily, you can often find fine preowned and vintage examples on the secondary market.


---


## **Understanding Hermès Leathers**


[Hermès Kelly 32 in Black Box Calf Leather, 1990s](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/top-handle-bags/hermes-1990s-kelly-32-black-box-leather-unisex-top-handle-handbag/id-v_29936952/)


[Hermès Birkin 25cm in Sable Togo Leather, 2025](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/top-handle-bags/hermes-birkin-25cm-sable-togo-leather-w-gold-hardware/id-v_29477472/)


The leathers used for Hermès bags fall into three categories: textured workhorse leathers, smooth or structured calfskins and ultrapremium exotic skins.


- Togo and Clemence are natural grained calfskins that are forgiving of light wear.


- Epsom is an embossed leather that is rigid and lightweight, known for holding its shape.


- Box Calf and Swift are smooth leathers that are prized for their appearance and color depth but are more apt to show scratches.


- Exotic leathers — crocodile, alligator, lizard, ostrich — are the rarest and most valuable category and command higher resale prices than calfskin.


Your bag’s material will impact its day-to-day care and resale value. Explore the[Hermès Birkin Bag Leather Guide](https://www.1stdibs.com/blogs/the-study/hermes-birkin-bag-leathers/) for a detailed breakdown by leather type.


---


## **Hermès Bag Sizes: How to Choose the Right One**


[Hermès Candy Birkin Bag 25 in Epsom Leather, Contemporary](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/top-handle-bags/hermes-candy-birkin-bag-epsom-25/id-v_20113862/)


[Hermès Kelly 28 Sellier Gold, Blue Celeste, Indigo in Epsom Leather, 2018](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/shoulder-bags/hermes-kelly-28-sellier-gold-blue-celeste-indigo-epsom-shoulder-bag/id-v_29590572/)


Standard sizes for Birkin bags are 25cm, 30cm, 35cm and 40cm, and standard sizes for Kelly bags are 25cm, 28cm, 32cm and 35cm.


- 25 is a compact evening or day option.
- 30 is a versatile everyday size.
- 35 and 40 are ideal sizes for work or travel.


Because Constance bags are worn crossbody or on the shoulder, its most popular core sizes are 18 (the “mini”) and 24.


First-time buyers may want to start with a Kelly 28 or a Birkin 30, since both sizes balance everyday usability with strong resale demand. Explore the[Hermès handbags collection](https://www.1stdibs.com/creators/hermes/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/) to compare available sizes and styles.

## **Verifying Authenticity and Reading the Blind Stamp**


[Hermes Birkin 25 Sellier in Gold Epsom Leather with Gold Hardware and a W Stamp, 21st century](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/top-handle-bags/hermes-birkin-25-sellier-gold-epsom-leather-gold-hardware-w-stamp-handbag/id-v_30134132/)


To authenticate your bag, look for the label stamp “Hermès Paris Made in France” (with a grave accent on the second e) centered and set close to the top stitching, in clean, fine lettering. A stamp that is blocky, heavy or off-center is a red flag.


- Stitches should be small, tight and not perfectly uniform.


- Hardware should be plated in palladium or gold and deeply engraved with *HERMÈS PARIS* .


### **The Blind Stamp System**


The blind stamp system consists of two stamps, found within the bag: a craftsman stamp, indicating the person or group who made the bag, and a date stamp, representing the production year. The former comprises shapes, letters, numbers and symbols. The latter consists of a letter, and, depending on the production era, a surrounding shape. The list below indicates how to interpret the stamp:


- No shape with a single letter (1945–70)
- Production letter in a circle (1971–96)
- Production letter in a square (1997–2014)
- No shape again, but with a single letter that is no longer assigned in a strict alphabetical order (2015 onward)


Note the blind stamp doesn’t imply authenticity or affect value on its own. Also, the type of leather can make it hard to read. A worn stamp isn’t necessarily a red flag.

## **What to Check Regarding Condition Before You Buy**


[Hermès Kelly 28 in Bicolore Epsom, 2000–09](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/top-handle-bags/sac-hermes-kelly-28-bicolore-epsom-bandouliere/id-v_30031362/)


Before buying, inspect the following.


- The highest-wear points: The feet should be intact, corners not crushed or discolored. The leather of the handle and strap should not be dry or cracked, signs of neglect. And the hardware plating should not show brassing or flaking, especially on gold-plated pieces.


- Interior condition: Check the lining for odors like smoke or mildew, which can be difficult to get rid of, and whether the bag holds its shape when empty.


Always ask the seller about past repairs or hardware replacement. When buying vintage, honest disclosure matters more than flawless-looking photos. A trusted[seller-vetting process](https://www.1stdibs.com/about/vetted-sellers/) helps reduce risk.


Learn more here:[Why the Hermès Birkin Bag Is a Surprisingly Savvy Investment](https://www.1stdibs.com/blogs/the-study/hermes-birkin-bag-value/) .

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What is the difference between a Birkin and a Kelly?**


The Birkin is an open-top tote secured by a flap, lock and key, without shoulder-length handle drop. The Kelly is a structured trapezoidal bag available in rigid Sellier or softer Retourne construction.


### **How can I tell if a Hermès bag is authentic?**


Check the stamp, stitching and hardware. Buying from a vetted seller who guarantees authenticity removes most of the risk.


### **What does the blind stamp tell me about a Hermès bag?**


It indicates the production year and sometimes the artisan. The date is denoted by a letter and, for certain periods, a surrounding shape. These can be checked against published Hermès date-stamp references.


### **What size Hermès bag should a first-time buyer choose?**


A Kelly 28 or Birkin 30 are the most versatile, resale-friendly starting sizes.


### **Do Hermès bags hold their value?**


Classic Birkin and Kelly styles in popular leathers and colors are historically among the most reliable resale performers in luxury fashion, although the exact value depends on condition, rarity and color.


### **Is a vintage or preowned Hermès bag cheaper than a new one?**


Rare or discontinued pieces can cost more than a comparable new bag, but for a Birkin or Kelly, buying preowned is often the only realistic way to avoid a multiyear waitlist.
